# Load phyloseq objects
```{r load phyloseq objects}
physeq_LT <- readRDS("LT_physeq_scrub_0.98clustered.rds") %>%
  subset_samples(!(animalID %in% c("EO4.2_MR", "EO4.2_ML", "EO4.6_ML", "EO4.2_MN", "EO4.7_MN", "EO4.11_FR", "EO4.5_FN"))) %>% # remove mice that died during experiment
  rename_sample_data(mouseID = animalID) %>% 
    mutate_sample_data(
      weeks_on_diet = age_weeks - 5,
      weeks_on_diet_factor = as.factor(weeks_on_diet),
      treatment = ifelse(treatment == "Control", "Ctrl", treatment),
      diet = str_replace(diet, "HF", "HFD"),
      treatment_diet = paste(treatment, diet, sep = "_")
    )

physeq_ST <- readRDS("ST_physeq_scrub_0.98clustered.rds") %>%
  rename_sample_data(mouseID = animal_ID) %>% 
  mutate_sample_data(
    weeks_on_diet = age_weeks - 6, 
    weeks_on_diet_factor = as.factor(weeks_on_diet),
    diet = str_replace(diet, "HF", "HFD"), 
    diet = str_replace(diet, "CTRL", "CD"), 
    diet_new = if_else(timepoint %in% c("t0", "t1"), "chow", diet),
    diet_new = factor(diet_new, levels = c("chow", "CD", "HFD")), 
    treatment_diet_new = paste(treatment, diet_new, sep = "_"),
    treatment_diet_new = factor(treatment_diet_new, levels = c("Ctrl_chow", "Ctrl_CD", "Ctrl_HFD", "Hp_chow", "Hp_CD", "Hp_HFD")), 
    sample_type = if_else(timepoint == "t4" & sample_type == "fecal", "colon", sample_type)
  )

```

```{r add Hp loads to phyloseq objects}
# Load Hp loads data
MS1_Hp_loads <- read_xlsx("MS1_Hp_loads.xlsx") %>%
  select(mouseID, experiment, total_bact_load, avg_copies, total_Hp_abund, total_DNA_conc, Hp_copies_std) 

# subset Hp loads data by experiment
MS1_Hp_loads_LT <- MS1_Hp_loads %>% 
  filter(experiment == "LT") %>%
  select(-experiment)
MS1_Hp_loads_ST <- MS1_Hp_loads %>% 
  filter(experiment == "ST") %>%
  select(-experiment)

# Add Hp loads to phyloseq objects
physeq_LT <- physeq_LT %>% 
  inner_join_sample_data(MS1_Hp_loads_LT, by = "mouseID") 
physeq_ST <- physeq_ST %>% 
  inner_join_sample_data(MS1_Hp_loads_ST, by = "mouseID") 

```


## prune and transform phyloseq objects 
```{r prune-taxa}
# For physeq_LT
physeq_LT_trans_abund_subset <- physeq_LT %>%
  ps_prune(min.samples = 3) %>%  # keeps only ASVs present in at least 3 samples
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%  # Removes taxa with zero abundance across all samples
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>%  # Transforms the counts to relative abundances by dividing each count by the total counts in that sample
  filter_taxa(function(x) mean(x) > 0.001, TRUE) %>%  # Filters out taxa with a mean relative abundance of 0.1% or less
  subset_taxa(Kingdom != "unassigned" & Family != "Mitochondria") %>%  # Removes taxa that are unassigned at the Kingdom level or belong to the Mitochondria family
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .)  # remove empty samples

# For physeq_ST
physeq_ST_trans_abund_subset <- physeq_ST %>%
  ps_prune(min.samples = 3) %>%  
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%  
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>%   
  filter_taxa(function(x) mean(x) > 0.001, TRUE) %>%  
  subset_taxa(Kingdom != "unassigned" & Family != "Mitochondria") %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) 

```

## Short-term 
### fecal samples
```{r ST: prepare fecal physeq object}
# Subset samples to include only fecal samples and non-NA treatments
physeq_ST_fecal <- physeq_ST_trans_abund_subset  %>%
  subset_samples(!is.na(treatment)) %>%
  subset_samples(timepoint != "t4") 
```

```{r ST: plot fecal beta diversity (Bray-Curtis)}
# Perform PCoA ordination using Bray-Curtis distance
physeq_ST_fecal_bray <- ordinate(physeq_ST_fecal, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

# Rename PCoA axes
colnames(physeq_ST_fecal_bray$vectors)[1:2] <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")

# Plot ordination
plot_physeq_ST_fecal_bray <- plot_ordination(physeq_ST_fecal, physeq_ST_fecal_bray, type = "samples", color = "weeks_on_diet_factor", shape = "treatment") +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("-2" = "#000099", "0" = "#0066ff", "1" = "#99ccff")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Ctrl" = 17, "Hp" = 19), labels = c("Ctrl" = "Control", "Hp" = expression(italic("H. pylori")))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank())

# Extract PCoA coordinates
colnames(physeq_ST_fecal_bray$vectors)[1:2] <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
physeq_ST_fecal_bray_coords <- physeq_ST_fecal_bray$vectors[, c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")]

# Combine with sample data
physeq_ST_fecal_sampledata <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_ST_fecal))
physeq_ST_fecal_bray_coords_df <- cbind(physeq_ST_fecal_sampledata, physeq_ST_fecal_bray_coords)

# Create boxplot for PCoA1
plot_physeq_ST_fecal_bray_pcoa1 <- ggplot(physeq_ST_fecal_bray_coords_df, aes(x = diet_new, y = PCoA1)) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = weeks_on_diet_factor, shape = treatment), height = 0, width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "transparent") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Ctrl" = 17, "Hp" = 19), labels = c("Ctrl" = "Control", "Hp" = expression(italic("H. pylori")))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("-2" = "#000099", "0" = "#0066ff", "1" = "#99ccff")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "PCoA1 [29 %]", color = "Time on diet (weeks)", shape = "Treatment") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

# Create boxplot for PCoA2
plot_physeq_ST_fecal_bray_pcoa2 <- ggplot(physeq_ST_fecal_bray_coords_df, aes(x = diet_new, y = PCoA2)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = weeks_on_diet_factor, shape = treatment), height = 0, width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "transparent") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Ctrl" = 17, "Hp" = 19), labels = c("Ctrl" = "Control", "Hp" = expression(italic("H. pylori")))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("-2" = "#000099", "0" = "#0066ff", "1" = "#99ccff")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "PCoA1 [11.3 %]", color = "Time on diet (weeks)", shape = "Treatment") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

# Arrange the plots
plot_physeq_ST_fecal_betadiv <- ggarrange(plot_physeq_ST_fecal_bray_pcoa2, plot_physeq_ST_fecal_bray, NULL, plot_physeq_ST_fecal_bray_pcoa1,
                          ncol = 2, 
                          nrow = 2, 
                          heights = c(3, 1), 
                          widths = c(1, 3), 
                          align = "hv",
                          common.legend = TRUE,
                          legend = "right")

plot_physeq_ST_fecal_betadiv
```

```{r}
#Bayesian analysis of betadiversity of fecal samples
#Extract Bray–Curtis distance matrix
bray_dist <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_ST_fecal, method = "bray")
bray_mat  <- as.matrix(bray_dist)

#Extract sample metadata
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_ST_fecal), check.names = FALSE)
meta$sampleID <- rownames(meta)
meta$sampleID <- as.character(meta$sampleID)
rownames(meta) <- NULL

#Convert to long format (pairwise distances)
bray_mat <- as.matrix(phyloseq::distance(physeq_ST_fecal, method = "bray"))

bray_long <- expand.grid(
  sample_i = rownames(bray_mat),
  sample_j = colnames(bray_mat),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

bray_long$bray <- bray_mat[
  cbind(match(bray_long$sample_i, rownames(bray_mat)),
        match(bray_long$sample_j, colnames(bray_mat)))
]

bray_long <- bray_long[bray_long$sample_i < bray_long$sample_j, ]


meta_i <- meta
names(meta_i) <- paste0(names(meta_i), "_i")

meta_j <- meta
names(meta_j) <- paste0(names(meta_j), "_j")

bray_long <- merge(
  bray_long,
  meta_i,
  by.x = "sample_i",
  by.y = "sampleID_i",
  all.x = TRUE
)

bray_long <- merge(
  bray_long,
  meta_j,
  by.x = "sample_j",
  by.y = "sampleID_j",
  all.x = TRUE
)


# Compute raw time difference
bray_long <- bray_long %>%
  mutate(time_diff = abs(weeks_on_diet_i - weeks_on_diet_j))

#Center and  scale
bray_long <- bray_long %>%
  mutate(
    time_diff = abs(weeks_on_diet_i - weeks_on_diet_j),
    time_diff_z = as.numeric(scale(time_diff)),
    both_post_diet = weeks_on_diet_i >= 0 & weeks_on_diet_j >= 0,
    one_post_diet  = xor(weeks_on_diet_i >= 0, weeks_on_diet_j >= 0)
  )

bray_long <- bray_long %>%
  select(-time_diff)

bray_wm <- bray_long %>%
  filter(mouseID_i == mouseID_j)
nrow(bray_wm)



bray_wm <- bray_wm %>%
  mutate(
    sex_pair = case_when(
      sex_i == "male" & sex_j == "male" ~ "both_male",
      sex_i == "female" & sex_j == "female" ~ "both_female",
      TRUE ~ "mixed"
    )
  )


bray_wm <- bray_wm %>%
  mutate(
    diet_stage_i = case_when(diet_i == "chow" ~ 0,
                             diet_i %in% c("CD","HFD") ~ 1),
    diet_stage_j = case_when(diet_j == "chow" ~ 0,
                             diet_j %in% c("CD","HFD") ~ 1),
    diet_stage_pair = (diet_stage_i + diet_stage_j)/2,
    both_post_diet = weeks_on_diet_i >= 0 & weeks_on_diet_j >= 0,
    one_post_diet  = xor(weeks_on_diet_i >= 0, weeks_on_diet_j >= 0),
    sex_pair = case_when(sex_i == "male" & sex_j == "male" ~ "both_male",
                         sex_i == "female" & sex_j == "female" ~ "both_female",
                         TRUE ~ "mixed"),
    infection_pair = case_when(treatment_i == "Hp" & treatment_j == "Hp" ~ "both_Hp",
                               treatment_i == "Ctrl" & treatment_j == "Ctrl" ~ "both_Ctrl",
                               TRUE ~ "mixed"),
    diet_post_pair = case_when(
      both_post_diet == FALSE ~ "Chow (pre-diet)",
      both_post_diet == TRUE & diet_i == "CD" & diet_j == "CD" ~ "CD (post-diet)",
      both_post_diet == TRUE & diet_i == "HFD" & diet_j == "HFD" ~ "HFD (post-diet)",
      both_post_diet == TRUE ~ "Mixed (post-diet)"
    )
  )


fit_bray_full_num <- brm(
   bray ~ time_diff_z +
       both_post_diet * infection_pair * sex_pair +
       (1 + time_diff_z | mouseID_i),
  data = bray_wm,
  family = Beta(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)


time_seq <- seq(min(bray_wm$time_diff_z), max(bray_wm$time_diff_z), length.out = 30)



pred_grid_forest <- expand.grid(
  time_diff_z = 0,
  sex_pair = c("both_male", "both_female"),
  infection_pair = c("both_Hp", "both_Ctrl"),
  diet_post_pair = c("Chow (pre-diet)", "CD (post-diet)", "HFD (post-diet)")
) %>%
  mutate(
    both_post_diet = ifelse(diet_post_pair == "Chow (pre-diet)", FALSE, TRUE),
    diet_stage_pair = ifelse(diet_post_pair == "Chow (pre-diet)", 0, 1)
  )



pred_draws_forest <- add_epred_draws(
  fit_bray_full_num,
  newdata = pred_grid_forest,
  re_formula = NA,  # population-level predictions only
  ndraws = 2000
)


eff_simple_treat <- pred_draws_forest %>%
  dplyr::select(.draw, sex_pair, diet_post_pair, infection_pair, .epred) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(.draw, sex_pair, diet_post_pair),
    names_from = infection_pair,
    values_from = .epred
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(effect = both_Hp - both_Ctrl) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sex_pair, diet_post_pair) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median    = median(effect, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Reorder diet and sex for plotting


eff_simple_treat <- eff_simple_treat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    diet_post_pair = factor(
      diet_post_pair,
      levels = rev(c("Chow (pre-diet)", "CD (post-diet)", "HFD (post-diet)"))
    ),
    sex_pair = factor(
      sex_pair,
      levels = c("both_female", "both_male"),
      labels = c("Female", "Male")
    )
  )

dodge_eff <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

ggplot(eff_simple_treat, aes(x = diet_post_pair, y = median, color = sex_pair)) +
  # 95% CI = thinner outer line
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
    position = dodge_eff,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  # 80% CI = thicker inner line
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
    position = dodge_eff,
    linewidth = 2.2
  ) +
  # median point
  geom_point(
    position = dodge_eff,
    size = 2.7
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Female" = "#b19cd9", "Male" = "#6a0dad"),
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Effect of Hp Infection on Bray–Curtis distance",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black")
  )


```



### GIT samples
```{r ST: prepare physeq object for gastrointestinal (GIT) samples}

# Subset samples to include only GIT samples and non-NA treatments
physeq_ST_git <- physeq_ST_trans_abund_subset  %>%
  subset_samples(!is.na(treatment)) %>%
  subset_samples(timepoint == "t4")

#make forest plots for colon, stomach and ileum - define plotting function

make_site_beta_forest <- function(fit_site, df_pcoa_site,
                                  ndraws = 2000,
                                  y_label = "Centroid distance in PCoA space (Bray–Curtis)") {

  
  # prediction grid
  grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    sex       = levels(df_pcoa_site$sex),
    diet      = levels(df_pcoa_site$diet),
    treatment = levels(df_pcoa_site$treatment)
  )

  # posterior expected PCs (population level)
  ep <- tidybayes::add_epred_draws(
    grid,
    fit_site,
    re_formula = NA,
    ndraws = ndraws
  )

  # widen to have PC1 and PC2 in columns
  ep_wide <- ep %>%
    dplyr::select(.draw, sex, diet, treatment, .category, .epred) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = .category, values_from = .epred)

  # helper: Euclidean distance between two conditions within a draw
  dist2 <- function(x1, y1, x2, y2) sqrt((x1 - x2)^2 + (y1 - y2)^2)

  # Marginalize over diet (treatment main effect) and over treatment (diet main effect)
  marg_treat <- ep_wide %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.draw, sex, treatment) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2), .groups = "drop")

  marg_diet <- ep_wide %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.draw, sex, diet) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2), .groups = "drop")

  # Main effects
  eff_main_treat <- marg_treat %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = c(PC1, PC2)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dist2(PC1_Hp, PC2_Hp, PC1_Ctrl, PC2_Ctrl)) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(.draw, sex, effect, type = "Main Effects", label = "Treatment")

  eff_main_diet <- marg_diet %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = c(PC1, PC2)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(effect = dist2(PC1_HFD, PC2_HFD, PC1_CD, PC2_CD)) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(.draw, sex, effect, type = "Main Effects", label = "Diet")

  # Simple effects
  eff_simple_treat <- ep_wide %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.draw, sex, diet) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      effect = dist2(
        PC1[treatment == "Hp"],   PC2[treatment == "Hp"],
        PC1[treatment == "Ctrl"], PC2[treatment == "Ctrl"]
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      type = "Simple Effects",
      label = paste0("Treatment in ", diet)
    )

  eff_simple_diet <- ep_wide %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.draw, sex, treatment) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      effect = dist2(
        PC1[diet == "HFD"], PC2[diet == "HFD"],
        PC1[diet == "CD"],  PC2[diet == "CD"]
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      type = "Simple Effects",
      label = paste0("Diet in ", treatment)
    )

  # Interaction: difference in treatment-distance between diets
  treat_effect_by_diet <- eff_simple_treat %>%
    dplyr::mutate(diet = sub("^Treatment in ", "", label)) %>%
    dplyr::select(.draw, sex, diet, effect)

  eff_interaction <- treat_effect_by_diet %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diet, values_from = effect) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(effect = HFD - CD) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      .draw, sex, effect,
      type = "Interaction",
      label = "Interaction"
    )

  # Combine all effect draws
  eff_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    eff_main_diet,
    eff_main_treat,
    eff_interaction,
    eff_simple_diet,
    eff_simple_treat
  )

  # Summaries for plotting with 95% and 80% intervals
  plot_df <- eff_all %>%
    dplyr::group_by(sex, type, label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      median    = median(effect),
      CI_low    = quantile(effect, 0.025),
      CI_high   = quantile(effect, 0.975),
      CI80_low  = quantile(effect, 0.10),
      CI80_high = quantile(effect, 0.90),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sex  = factor(sex, levels = c("female", "male"), labels = c("Female", "Male")),
      type = factor(type, levels = c("Main Effects", "Interaction", "Simple Effects"))
    )

  # row order (bottom-to-top after coord_flip)
  label_levels <- c(
    "Diet in Ctrl",
    "Diet in Hp",
    "Treatment in CD",
    "Treatment in HFD",
    "Interaction",
    "Diet",
    "Treatment"
  )

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label = factor(label, levels = label_levels),
      label = forcats::fct_rev(label)
    )

  dodge_beta <- ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.6)

  # Forest plot with 95% thin line + 80% thick line
  betaplot <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = label, y = median, color = sex)) +
    ggplot2::geom_linerange(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
      position = dodge_beta,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_linerange(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = CI80_low, ymax = CI80_high),
      position = dodge_beta,
      linewidth = 2.2
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(shape = type),
      position = dodge_beta,
      size = 2.7
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#b19cd9", "Male" = "#6a0dad")) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(
      "Main Effects"   = 16,
      "Interaction"    = 18,
      "Simple Effects" = 15
    )) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.y        = ggplot2::element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.box         = "vertical"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "",
      y = y_label,
      color = "Sex",
      shape = "Effect type"
    )

  list(
    eff_all = eff_all,
    plot_df = plot_df,
    betaplot = betaplot
  )
}


#run site-specific analyses
run_site_pcoa_pipeline <- function(physeq, site_name,
                                  ndraws = 2000,
                                  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000,
                                  seed = 123) {

  stopifnot(inherits(physeq, "phyloseq"))
  stopifnot(is.character(site_name), length(site_name) == 1)

  # --- subset safely (avoid subset_samples NSE issues) ---
  meta0 <- as(phyloseq::sample_data(physeq), "data.frame")
  stopifnot("sample_type" %in% colnames(meta0))

  keep_ids <- rownames(meta0)[meta0$sample_type == site_name]
  if (length(keep_ids) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No samples matched site_name = '", site_name, "'. ",
      "Available sample_type values: ",
      paste(unique(meta0$sample_type), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  physeq_site <- phyloseq::prune_samples(keep_ids, physeq)

  # --- metadata (site) ---
  meta_site <- as(phyloseq::sample_data(physeq_site), "data.frame") %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sampleID") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Ctrl","Hp")),
      sex       = factor(sex, levels = c("female","male")),
      diet      = factor(diet, levels = c("CD","HFD"))
    )

  # --- Bray–Curtis + PCoA ---
  bray_site <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_site, method = "bray")

  pcoa_site <- cmdscale(bray_site, k = 3, eig = TRUE)
  scores_site <- as.data.frame(pcoa_site$points)
  colnames(scores_site) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(ncol(scores_site)))
  scores_site$sampleID <- rownames(scores_site)

  df_pcoa_site <- dplyr::inner_join(meta_site, scores_site, by = "sampleID")

  # --- multivariate model ---
  bf1 <- brms::bf(PC1 ~ treatment * diet * sex)
  bf2 <- brms::bf(PC2 ~ treatment * diet * sex)

  priors_mv <- c(
    brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", resp = "PC1"),
    brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", resp = "PC2"),
    brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "PC1"),
    brms::prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept", resp = "PC2"),
    brms::prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma", resp = "PC1"),
    brms::prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma", resp = "PC2"),
    brms::prior(lkj(2), class = "rescor")
  )

  fit_site <- brms::brm(
    bf1 + bf2 + brms::set_rescor(TRUE),
    data = df_pcoa_site,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors_mv,
    chains = chains, iter = iter, warmup = warmup,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    seed = seed
  )

  list(
    site   = site_name,
    physeq = physeq_site,
    meta   = meta_site,
    bray   = bray_site,
    df_pcoa = df_pcoa_site,
    fit    = fit_site
  )
}


res_ileum   <- run_site_pcoa_pipeline(physeq_ST_git, "ileum")
res_colon   <- run_site_pcoa_pipeline(physeq_ST_git, "colon")
res_stomach <- run_site_pcoa_pipeline(physeq_ST_git, "stomach")


#plot
forest_colon   <- make_site_beta_forest(res_colon$fit,   res_colon$df_pcoa)
forest_ileum   <- make_site_beta_forest(res_ileum$fit,   res_ileum$df_pcoa)
forest_stomach <- make_site_beta_forest(res_stomach$fit, res_stomach$df_pcoa)

forest_colon$betaplot
forest_ileum$betaplot
forest_stomach$betaplot
```

```{r}
make_pcoa_plot <- function(physeq, site_name) {

  # extract metadata
  meta <- as(phyloseq::sample_data(physeq), "data.frame")

  # find samples for this site
  keep_ids <- rownames(meta)[meta$sample_type == site_name]

  # prune samples
  physeq_site <- phyloseq::prune_samples(keep_ids, physeq)

  # ordination
  ord <- phyloseq::ordinate(physeq_site, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

  # rename axes
  colnames(ord$vectors)[1:2] <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")

  # plot
  p <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(
    physeq_site, ord,
    type = "samples",
    color = "treatment"
  ) +
    facet_grid(sex ~ diet_new) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Ctrl" = "#0072B2", "Hp" = "#E69F00"),
      labels = c("Control", expression(italic("H. pylori")))
    ) +
    ggtitle(toupper(site_name)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "none",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.margin = margin(c(1, 5, 5, 5)),
      legend.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.75),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))

  return(p)
}



sites <- c("colon", "ileum", "stomach")

plots <- lapply(sites, function(site) {
  make_pcoa_plot(physeq_ST_git, site)
})

names(plots) <- sites

plots$colon
plots$ileum
plots$stomach
```

```{r}
composite_fig
```
